Member Function Documentation

◆ GetNumElements()

int superdex::PerElementSoftMaterialData::GetNumElements ( ) const
nodiscard

Number of elements described by this per-element material field.

Derived from the per-element array appropriate to type: arapStiffness for the ARAP-family materials (SoftMaterialType::Arap and SoftMaterialType::ActiveShapeTargetingArap), and poissonRatio for the Lame-based materials.

Returns
Number of elements.
